title: I'm building a Dark Medieval Fantasy Extraction RPG
author: ElBatchos
selftext:
Hey everyone!

Here's a look at a part of the main town I've been working on for my dark medieval fantasy sword & magic extraction RPG!

Around 99% of the development work involves AI. I use it for a lot of different things :

For the 3D workflow, I use Blender MCP with Python scripts, using real photos, images and paintings as references.

For animations, I filmed myself doing the movements and used the MetaHuman Animator Marker plugin, which I found on Fab through the Epic Games Launcher, to turn them into animations. Then I used AI to fix and improve them with some more specific instructions.

I've spent quite a lot of time setting up workflows for my AI agents. 

For things like 3D assets or spells, I first make one example and keep working on it until I'm happy with the result. Once it's right, I turn the process into a workflow and document it in my project bible, so the other agents can reuse the same rules and references.

Some people might think the result is ugly or just AI slop, and that's fine. Personally, I'm pretty happy with how it's going so far!

I'm aiming for a closed alpha test on Steam around January-February 2027.

The plan for the alpha is to have:

* 7 classes, with progression up to level 10
* 3 different ultimates per class, plus spells and passives
* 4 types of mobs and 1 boss
* 500+ different items with 5 rarity tiers, including "Unique" tier
* A map for around 15 players per match, maybe a few more

There's still a lot to do before then, but that's the goal!

If this looks like your kind of game, feel free to follow my posts. I'll share more of the development as I go!
